# Test fixtures

Six real gen9ou replays and the engine analyses produced from them.

Copied 2026-09-06 from `battle-brain/BattleBrain/Resources/{analysis,replays}/`, which is
where they are bundled into the iOS app. They were generated by `battle-engine`'s
`scripts/analyze_replay.py` at ladder-parity settings: 1000 ms per turn, 8 opponent
samples, 4 threads, usage-stats cutoff 1500, poke-engine `v0.0.48`.

They are copied rather than read across the repo boundary because `battle-brain` is not a
dependency of this repo and CI will not have it checked out. Reading `../battle-brain/...`
worked on one developer's machine and nowhere else.

`analysis/<id>.json` and `replays/<id>.json` pair by replay id. The pairing is what makes
`estimateTurns` testable: counting `|turn|` lines in the raw payload must reproduce the
analysis document's own `totalTurns`, and it does for all six.

Do not regenerate these casually. The search is budgeted in wall-clock milliseconds rather
than node counts, so re-running the engine produces different visit shares on a different
machine or under different load. These are records of specific runs, not reproducible
outputs.
